rationale: Perspective images with no demonstrated extreme fisheye projection; use standard radial k1,k2,k3 and tangential p1,p2 model without extra rational parameters.
fit_split: 27 fit observations only; validation split frozen before fitting
validation: Estimate independent board pose with fixed fitted K and distortion; never refit K/distortion on validation.
limitations: Same-session validation and operator-reported measurements; no independent-session verification or sensor timing certification. Residual gates are this experiment's predeclared geometric checks, not system/controller acceptance.
